### `sticker fave add`

Add a sticker to favourites.

```
tlgr sticker fave add [STICKER]... [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · idempotent (reports `already`) · returns `FaveResult`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `STICKER` | text | any number | <set>/<index> or <set>/<emoji>. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--from-message` | text |  | Take the sticker from this message. |

```console
$ tlgr sticker fave add AnimatedEmojies/0 --json
```

### `sticker pack create`

Create your own sticker, mask or custom-emoji pack.

```
tlgr sticker pack create [SHORT_NAME] [OPTIONS]
```

**mutating · returns `PackCreated`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SHORT_NAME` | text | no | URL name; omit to have one suggested. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--add` | text |  | A sticker to seed the pack with. |
| `--convert/--no-convert` | flag | `True` | Convert inputs to the required format first. |
| `--manifest` | path |  | JSON manifest of files and emoji. |
| `--software` | text | `tlgr` | Creating-software tag. |
| `--text-color` | flag |  | Emoji packs: render in the message text colour. |
| `--thumb` | path |  | Pack thumbnail. |
| `--title` | text |  | Display title. |
| `--type` | sticker|mask|emoji | `sticker` | Pack kind. |

```console
$ tlgr sticker pack create my_cats_by_tlgr --title 'My cats' --add cat.webp:🐱 --json
```

### `sticker set get`

One sticker set with all its stickers, emoji map and keywords.

Each sticker row carries the document id, its emoji, its keywords and its index, which is what `sticker fave add` and `message send --sticker <set>/<index>` consume. The share link is string formatting, not a request: t.me/addstickers/<name>, or t.me/addemoji/<name> for an emoji set.

```
tlgr sticker set get [SET] [OPTIONS]
```

**returns `StickerSet`**

| Argument | Type | Required | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `SET` | text | no | Short name, t.me link, or <id>:<hash>. |

| Flag | Type | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--convert` | png|json|none | `none` | Post-process downloads: TGS to Lottie JSON. |
| `--download` | path |  | Download every sticker into here. |
| `--effects` | flag |  | Also download premium effect videos. |
| `--from-message` | text |  | Take the set from a message's sticker. |
| `--link` | flag |  | Print only the shareable set link. |
| `--system` | text |  | A system set: dice:EMOJI, animated-emoji, topic-icons, default-statuses… |
| `--thumb` | flag |  | Also download the set thumbnail. |

Also invocable as: `tlgr emoji set get`

```console
$ tlgr sticker set get AnimatedEmojies --json
```

<details><summary>Catalog coverage (5 full, 1 partial)</summary>

Full: `media.animated-emoji`, `sticker.dice-and-system-sets`, `sticker.download-assets`, `sticker.set-view`, `sticker.share-link`

Partial: `emoji.custom-sets`

Custom-emoji sets take the same calls; `emoji set get` is this command.

</details>
